title: Spicy Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional Jamaican jerk chicken, served on skewers for a fun and easy meal.

ingredients.name: scotch bonnet peppers
ingredients.notes: diced, for their heat and flavor

ingredients.name: wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, scotch bonnet peppers, jerk seasoning, and brown sugar.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
